items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I know Henry Martin and Martin and all them fellas

ctx.x: Was it Henry Martin, was he always? Yeah. I used to hear it.
Oh, Henry Martin, yeah, but I mean, at my time when I was coming, I know Henry Martin and Martin and all them fellas, but they wasn't sitting in at that time with Mr. Perry.
Do you remember Red Happy, who used to be a drummer and all that?
